appearances.whereabouts: Traveling the Caemlyn Road through low hills, fleeing Trollocs; fights in battle against Trolloc/Myrddraal force; enters ruins of Shadar Logoth at chapter end
appearances.notable_actions: Wields Tam's sword in battle against Trollocs; shouts 'Manetheren!' warcry; cuts catchpoles and fights Trollocs; nearly pulled from saddle; worries about friends' safety; reflects on battle experience and warcries; observes ruined city
appearances.demeanor: Frightened but determined in battle; confused and ashamed by thoughts that Mat might be the real target; awed by Moiraine's power and the ruins of Shadar Logoth

appearances.whereabouts: Leading group along Caemlyn Road and through hills; scouts Trolloc positions alone; fights Myrddraal; leads group to Shadar Logoth
appearances.notable_actions: Sets hard pace; scouts enemy positions and reports five hundred Trollocs; engages Myrddraal in single combat (his sword clashes with black blade, creating blue light and bell-like sounds); catches Moiraine when she wavers; chooses route to avoid leaving clear trail; leads group into Shadar Logoth
appearances.demeanor: Vigilant, tactical, protective; shows rare worry when searching for safe route; argues with Moiraine about destination

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling with group; fights Trollocs; leads group to Shadar Logoth
appearances.notable_actions: Uses staff to strike down Trollocs with flame; creates earthquake that topples Trollocs; raises wall of fire to block pursuit; lays false scent trail with staff; becomes weakened from channeling; uses angreal; argues with Lan about destination; reveals Aridhol/Shadar Logoth's history
appearances.demeanor: Powerful and commanding during battle; exhausted and weakened afterward; swaying in saddle and needing support; irritable when arguing with Lan

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling with group through hills; in battle against Trollocs; enters Shadar Logoth
appearances.notable_actions: Complains about cheese and lack of tea; rides close to Moiraine with belt knife during battle; briefly understands Mat's ancient warcry; observes and questions about ruined city
appearances.demeanor: Uncomfortable with travel conditions; fierce during battle despite limited weapons; curious and uncertain about ancient blood/warcry revelation; wondering about the mysterious city

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling with group; fights in battle; enters Shadar Logoth
appearances.notable_actions: Shouts ancient Manetheren warcry in Old Tongue without understanding it ('Carai an Caldazar! Carai an Ellisande! Al Ellisande!'); unhorsed during battle but remounts; fights with bow; cannot remember or explain the warcry afterward
appearances.demeanor: Confused and defensive about the ancient warcry; scowling and frowning when Moiraine suggests he has royal blood; uncomfortable with implications; frightened during battle

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling with group; fights in battle; enters Shadar Logoth
appearances.notable_actions: Questions why they don't go cross-country; fights with axe; nearly pulled from saddle by three Trollocs; shouts 'Manetheren!' warcry; observes that the ruined city has no people and walls are falling
appearances.demeanor: Thoughtful and observant; hunched and fearful during pursuit; struggles in battle; experiences guilty thoughts about being the Trollocs' target

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling with group; in battle; enters Shadar Logoth
appearances.notable_actions: Discusses herbs with Moiraine (flatwort tea, andilay root); rides with belt knife during battle close to Moiraine and Egwene; gives Moiraine a medicinal packet after battle; supports weakened Moiraine in saddle; defends Lan's tracking ability; shows concern for Moiraine despite antagonism
appearances.demeanor: Persistently antagonistic toward Moiraine but simultaneously protective and concerned; jaw tightening with irritation; slight satisfaction after giving herbs; fierce during battle

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling with group; fights in battle; enters Shadar Logoth
appearances.notable_actions: Corrects Mat's retelling of stories; shares knowledge about Myrddraal ('won't die until nightfall'); mutters and stares back at pursuit; chews mustaches; has speculative frown about 'Seven Towers' title; struggles to control mount during horn calls; urges group to move on
appearances.demeanor: Knowledgeable and observant; nervous and half-frightened by Trolloc horns; pragmatic about danger; uncomfortable with Aes Sedai/Warder argument

appearances.whereabouts: Carrying Rand through flight and battle
appearances.notable_actions: Screams and rears during battle; lashes out with hooves at Trollocs; fights with bit in teeth; struggles forward through enemies; twists and fights when Rand is caught by hook

appearances.whereabouts: Carrying Moiraine through flight and battle
appearances.notable_actions: Responds to Moiraine's subtle commands during battle (dashes and cuts at slightest touch); becomes riderless briefly when Lan dismounts to catch Moiraine; staggers when earth shakes

appearances.whereabouts: Carrying Lan through flight and battle
appearances.notable_actions: Gallops with Lan on reconnaissance; matches step-for-step with Myrddraal's horse during Lan's duel; never misses a step despite earth-shaking; staggers when ground trembles
appearances.demeanor: Steady and battle-trained despite supernatural opponents
